presets.label: GoHighLevel
presets.who: Any HighLevel account; you pick the sub-accounts at sign-in.

token.label: Private Integration Token
token.help: In HighLevel: Settings, Private Integrations, create a token. Untested against HighLevel's server, so try the sign-in first.

presets.note: Works across many sub-accounts at once. Do not use the /mcp/anthropic address: it accepts only Claude.

token.label: Linear API key
token.help: In Linear: Settings, Security and access, Personal API keys.

presets.label: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence)
presets.who: Anyone with an Atlassian cloud site.

presets.label: Asana
presets.who: Anyone with an Asana account; you make one small app first.

oauth.help: In Asana open app.asana.com/0/my-apps, make an MCP app, copy its client ID and secret into a vault item, and add http://127.0.0.1:53682/connect/callback as its redirect address.

presets.note: Asana's discovery names a server with no registration, so this uses your own app.

presets.label: ClickUp
presets.who: Anyone with a ClickUp account. The free plan allows 50 calls a day.

presets.label: monday.com

token.label: Personal API token
token.help: In monday.com: profile picture, Developers, My access tokens.

presets.note: monday reserves its sign-in for marketplace partners, so a personal token is the sure way.

presets.label: Trello
presets.who: Anyone with a Trello account. Comments and attachments are not covered.

presets.label: Canva
presets.who: Anyone with a Canva account; brand kits need Pro.

presets.label: Fathom
presets.who: Fathom accounts on a plan that includes it.

presets.label: GitHub

token.label: Personal access token
token.help: In GitHub: Settings, Developer settings, Fine-grained tokens.

presets.note: Signing in goes through GitHub's own login on the GitHub card. A pasted token works too.

presets.label: Vercel
presets.who: Anyone with a Vercel account. Vercel lists the apps it allows, so sign-in may refuse Vyre.

token.label: Neon API key
token.help: In Neon: Account settings, API keys.

token.label: Cloudflare API token
token.help: In Cloudflare: My Profile, API Tokens.

token.label: Personal API key
token.help: In PostHog: Account settings, Personal API keys.

presets.label: Mixpanel (US)
presets.who: Accounts made after 1 Aug 2026; older ones need an org admin to turn it on.

presets.label: Amplitude (US)
presets.who: Anyone with an Amplitude account; an admin can restrict it.

token.label: Apify API token
token.help: In Apify: Settings, API and Integrations.

presets.label: Intercom (US)
presets.who: Anyone with an Intercom workspace hosted in the US.

token.label: Intercom access token
token.help: In Intercom: Settings, Developers, your app's access token.

presets.label: Intercom (EU)
presets.who: Anyone with an Intercom workspace hosted in the EU.

token.label: Intercom access token
token.help: In Intercom: Settings, Developers, your app's access token.

presets.label: HubSpot
presets.who: HubSpot account admins; you make one small app first.

oauth.help: In HubSpot open Development, create an app with a user-level install, copy its client ID and secret into a vault item, and add http://127.0.0.1:53682/connect/callback as its redirect address.

presets.note: HubSpot's server has no automatic registration.

token.label: Agent API key
token.help: In Stripe: Developers, API keys, make a key with the Agent tag.

presets.label: Square
presets.who: Square accounts. Square lists the apps it allows, so sign-in may refuse Vyre.

presets.label: Zapier
presets.who: Zapier plans with tasks; each call costs 2 tasks.

token.label: Connection token
token.help: In Zapier: mcp.zapier.com, make a server, copy its token.

presets.label: Exa
presets.who: Anyone; the free tier needs no account.

presets.label: Context7
presets.who: Anyone; the free tier needs no account.

presets.label: Google Mail
presets.who: Google Workspace accounts in Google's Developer Preview only. Personal Gmail is not supported by Google's server.

oauth.help: In Google Cloud make a Desktop OAuth client, copy its client ID and secret into a vault item, then sign in.

presets.note: Google's server has no send tool: it drafts.

presets.label: Google Calendar
presets.who: Google Workspace accounts in Google's Developer Preview only.

oauth.help: In Google Cloud make a Desktop OAuth client, copy its client ID and secret into a vault item, then sign in.

presets.label: Google Drive
presets.who: Google Workspace accounts in Google's Developer Preview only.

oauth.help: In Google Cloud make a Desktop OAuth client, copy its client ID and secret into a vault item, then sign in.

presets.label: Meta Ads
presets.who: Anyone with access to an ad account.

token.label: Meta access token
token.help: In Meta for Developers: Tools, Graph API Explorer or a System User token with ads_management.

unavailable.label: Slack
unavailable.reason: Slack's server accepts only directory or internal apps that a workspace admin approves. It has no automatic registration.

unavailable.label: Dropbox
unavailable.reason: Dropbox allows only its trusted partners to register.

unavailable.label: Figma
unavailable.reason: Figma limits its server to apps in its own catalog.

unavailable.label: Box
unavailable.reason: Box needs an administrator to switch its server on.

unavailable.label: Calendly
unavailable.reason: Calendly refused a sign-in from a local address on 30 Sep 2026 with no reason given.

unavailable.label: WordPress.com
unavailable.reason: WordPress.com refused a sign-in from a local address on 30 Sep 2026, and needs a paid plan.

unavailable.label: Microsoft 365
unavailable.reason: Microsoft's servers need a work tenant and an administrator. Use an API credential in the vault instead.
